title: t3bus event
description: Every live (non-retained) message on the t3bus is one of these. Retained state topics (agent/+/state, agent/+/subagents, cron/status, cron/jobs) carry bare values instead.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 with offset, when it happened

source.description: who emitted it, e.g. t3cron, claude/flo-chonkler-opus, cli

attention.description: a human should look at this
